APPROVE
`Lex` now scores roughly 10, the extracted helpers (`CommentEnd`, `LexLiteral`, `LexRawString`, `StringEnd`, `BlankRange`) keep the original branch logic intact (including `next is '/' or '*'`, which binds as `next is ('/' or '*')`), and nothing introduces new warnings, though this rests on reading the diff rather than a build, and assumes no other part of the partial class already defines these helper names.
